topic: Write a Reply about Your Plans for the Future(写一封回信谈你对未来的计划)
genre: 书信 / 记叙·描述未来计划(reply to a pen-friend about future plans)
source: 外研社选择性必修第二册 Unit 1 Using language:write a reply to tell a friend about your own plans for the future(用将来进行时描述未来安排)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,你的笔友 Diana 来信问你对未来的打算。请用英语写一封约80词的回信,内容包括:① 一年后(成年时)你将会在做什么;② 几年后你打算在大学学什么;③ 长远来看你希望从事什么职业。注意:多用将来进行时(this time next year, I will be doing…),句子围绕中心、连贯自然。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Your pen-friend Diana has asked about your plans for the future. Write a reply (about 80 words) including: 1) what you will be doing in a year's time, when you become an adult; 2) what you plan to study at university; 3) what job you hope to do in the long term. Try to use the future continuous (e.g. 'This time next year, I will be …').
points: 一年后的安排(In a year's time, I will be …)
大学的打算(In a couple of years, I will be studying …)
长远的职业理想(In the long term, I hope I will be working as …)
多用将来进行时、句子连贯、围绕'未来计划'中心
model_essay: Dear Diana, Thank you for your letter! You asked about my plans for the future, so here they are. This time next year, I will be an adult, and I will be taking my final school exams. With luck, I will pass them all. In a couple of years, I will be studying law at university, because I really want to help people. In the long term, I hope that one day I will be working as a judge. Let's see how things go! Best wishes, Li Hua
model_translation: 亲爱的 Diana,谢谢你的来信!你问起我对未来的打算,那我就说说看。明年的这个时候,我就成年了,那时我正在参加期末考试。运气好的话,我会全部通过。再过几年,我会在大学读法律,因为我真的很想帮助别人。从长远看,我希望有一天能当一名法官。看看事情会怎样发展吧!此致,李华

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:一年后的安排 / 大学的打算 / 长远职业理想
书信格式完整、围绕'未来计划'展开、句句相关、行文连贯
将来进行时(will be doing)运用得当、词汇句型准确多样、语法基本无误

required_structure: 称呼与感谢 Dear Diana, Thank you for your letter!
一年后 This time next year, I will be …
大学 In a couple of years, I will be studying …
长远 In the long term, I hope I will be working as …
key_expressions: This time next year, I will be an adult.
I will be taking my final school exams.
In a couple of years, I will be studying law at university.
In the long term, I hope I will be working as a judge.

high_sentences: This time next year, I will be an adult, and I will be taking my final school exams.
In a couple of years, I will be studying law at university.
In the long term, I hope that one day I will be working as a judge.

error_pairs.wrong: This time next year, I will take my final exams.
error_pairs.correct: This time next year, I will be taking my final exams.
error_pairs.note: 表将来某一时刻正在进行的动作,用 will be doing。

error_pairs.wrong: In a couple of years, I am studying at university.
error_pairs.correct: In a couple of years, I will be studying at university.
error_pairs.note: 表将来正在进行,用 will be doing,而非现在进行时。

error_pairs.wrong: I hope I will working as a judge.
error_pairs.correct: I hope I will be working as a judge.
error_pairs.note: 将来进行时结构是 will be + doing,不能省略 be。

paragraph_template:
【未来计划回信结构】

结尾:Let's see how things go! Best wishes, …
